{{Quote|Once these models go into production, the Republic's troops will fall like ''tauntaun flesh'' under a ''laser knife''!|[[Unidentified Neimoidian councilor|A Neimoidian councilor]], to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Update">{{TCWComicCite|6.53|Update}}</ref>}}
A '''laser knife''' was a small weapon that created a small beam of light energy from its hilt, like a miniature [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Though the '''laser knife''' was much smaller than a lightsaber, it functioned almost exactly the same, being able to cut through matter. The technical layouts of this weapon are unknown. There are records of this weapon being used in the criminal underworld of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and some time during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
